extracted.name: Martha's Vegetable Beef Soup
extracted.description: Ground beef and a package of frozen vegetables are your two main shopping list items for this quick-to-make soup. The hearty, flavorful broth is made with tomato sauce, dry onion soup mix, and a teaspoon of white sugar.
instruction_lines: In a large pot over medium high heat, saute the ground beef for about 5 minutes, or until browned. Drain off excess fat.
Add the tomatoes, sauce, water, vegetables, soup mix and sugar. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
